name: Quiet signal / editorial pixel
authorship: Authored LitCodex starting direction; not derived from the immutable reference corpus.
principles: oversized editorial headings with deliberate line breaks

grid.vector_rendering: grid-aligned rect cells with crisp edges

integration: Tie the illustration subject to the requested product or content, not just interface chrome.
Keep the artwork prominent and recognizable at 320px without horizontal overflow.
Recompose the full illustration for 320px, 390px, and 1440px instead of shrinking or hiding it.
Echo one artwork color in a nearby interface detail while preserving text and control contrast.
not_sufficient: Smooth orbit or line art as the only featured illustration.
An isolated pixel icon or background grid without an integrated subject illustration.

surface_rules: Use typography, spacing, and one deliberate contrast shift to establish hierarchy.
Keep pixel edges crisp and original; do not blur or upscale low-resolution art with smoothing.
Use an atmospheric field as a restrained background treatment, not a substitute for content contrast.
Keep navigation and controls quiet, legible, and clearly interactive.

motion.principle: Motion explains state change and never carries essential information alone.
motion.reduced_motion: Remove nonessential movement and preserve the same information and action.

responsive.reflow: Recompose hierarchy and line breaks for compact widths; do not merely scale the desktop canvas.
